x: Tragedy struck in the Surrey when Wilf Wesch, last year's winner missed his train leaving Ray Hall to close the Belgrave four in behind Surrey Walking Club. Carl Lawton confirmed his recent strong form with a fine win of just 3 seconds over the tenacious Ken Carter of Surrey.
In the 5km Ken Carter of Southend won easily despite a late rally by Allan Callow and Peter Selby. Len Duquemin walked steadily home for 4th.

We started the ball rolling with a 2nd for John Hall in the 3 kilos behind Ken Carter (Southend). Then,in the 10 kilos, where a very slow time was produced, Carl Lawton won from John Moullin in the sticky conditions.
